description: Convert a dynamic DHCP lease to static (make-static) or remove a lease. Idempotent by MAC address.

action.description: Action to perform: make-static converts a dynamic lease to static; remove deletes the lease

macAddress.description: MAC address of the lease — idempotency key (case-insensitive)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: manage_dhcp_lease
title: Manage DHCP Lease
